Concept Extraction.Notes: Pivot classes (reified relations) are used for BandMembership (Person-Band-Time-Role), AlbumRecording (Album-Time), TrackRecording (Track-Song), SongComposition (Song-Date), CriticReview (Critic-Album-Review), PerformanceSetlist (Performance-Song), and for spatial containment (City-Region, Region-Country).

CQ Coverage Verification.CQ15: owl:someValuesFrom restriction: Album subClassOf (hasTrack some Track)

cq_coverage.1: playsInstrument property connects Person and Instrument, answering what instruments a person plays.
cq_coverage.2: BandMembership pivot class connects Person, Band, and Time (membershipStart, membershipEnd) to answer band members at a time.
cq_coverage.3: BandMembership also includes Role (hasRole), so Person-Band-Role-Time is captured.
cq_coverage.4: AlbumRecording pivot class with properties recordingStart/End and recordsAlbum covers album recording period.
cq_coverage.5: albumTrackCount data property on Album gives track count.
cq_coverage.6: albumReleaseDate data property on Album answers album release date.
cq_coverage.7: TrackRecording pivot class connects Track and Song (trackIsRecordingOf) to relate a track to a song.
cq_coverage.8: SongComposition pivot class with songComposedOn data property models song composition date.
cq_coverage.9: CriticReview pivot class with reviewedBy, criticReviewOf, and reviewText covers critic statements about albums.
cq_coverage.10: performanceDate data property on Performance answers performance dates.
cq_coverage.11: PerformanceSetlist pivot class links Performance and Song (setlistSong) for songs played in a performance.
cq_coverage.12: performanceLocation property links Performance to City for location.
cq_coverage.13: cityInRegion property links City and Region for region of a city.
cq_coverage.14: regionInCountry property links Region and Country for country of a region.
cq_coverage.15: Album subclass axiom with owl:someValuesFrom on hasTrack ensures every Album has at least one Track.

pitfalls.name: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared
pitfalls.description: This pitfall appears when any relationship (except for those that are defined as symmetric properties using owl:SymmetricProperty) does not have an inverse relationship (owl:inverseOf) defined within the ontology.

iterations.fix_applied: Added owl:inverseOf declarations for all object properties that did not have them.
Ontology now passes both syntax and pitfall validation.
